tagline: Fixes: modded NPCs with Penumbra and Glamourer, lobby and markers.

entries.headline: A bug-fix update: modded NPCs work again with the current versions of Penumbra and Glamourer, and the lobby and markers finally behave as intended.

sections.title: Modded NPCs: Penumbra and Glamourer
items: Players see your NPCs' mods again. Those already there when you placed the NPC saw its base version: Penumbra refused to apply its mods for them.
A modded NPC keeps its mods when it moves to another room: opening a lobby, a scene taken over by another GM.

A modded NPC only appears for players once its files are uploaded, which takes a few seconds depending on their size. A player whose files have not arrived yet waits a moment instead of showing the base version.

sections.title: Lobby
items: A player you invite into your party now joins you, instead of pulling you into their lobby as a mere player.
A GM whose lobby still has other players keeps it, even when invited into another party.

sections.title: Markers
items: A marker removed by the GM now also disappears for players in a lobby, who used to keep seeing it.
"Despawn all" in the Scene view now also removes markers, not just NPCs.
